numericFiringOriginNote: Main TARGET projectile origins are the numerical mount plus lateral barrel offset (z=0), not the physical tube tip. Muzzle markers sit at physical forward tips; gameplay must retain its existing numerical firing formulas. Auxiliary manual and automatic origins are also numeric simulation points, not these cosmetic markers.

groupSchema.grouping: One entry per manual group or actual automatic bank; automatic banks sharing a controlId share WeaponGroup-<controlId> and use globally unique mount indices within that control. Main uses the mandatory Turret/Elevation/Barrel/Muzzle hierarchy.
groupSchema.names: GLB names contain original controlId colons. Three GLTFLoader sanitizes them; use the recorded loaded* names after loading. Auxiliary roots are named WeaponGroup-<controlId>, containing Mount-<controlId>-<index> -> Pivot-<controlId>-<index> -> WeaponBarrel-<controlId>-<index>-<barrel> -> WeaponMuzzle-<controlId>-<index>-<barrel>.
groupSchema.aircraft: Main aircraft entry has target counts but mounts=[]; distinct AircraftLaunch/AircraftRecovery local points replace visual gun mounts.
groupSchema.angles: Radians; +Z forward; Mount absolute local yaw, Pivot.rotation.x=-elevation. baseYaw is rest orientation, not an extra angle to add to simulation absolute yaw.
groupSchema.recoil: Each barrel group starts at local z=0. Apply recoil as negative local Z, restore to zero. Muzzle is a physical-tip child; it is not a numerical firing origin.
